analysis.purpose: The test suite for MuleExtractor — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: MuleExtractor — dispatch + supports; MuleExtractor — config role (flows, processors, routers, handlers); MuleExtractor — properties role (keys only, never values); MuleExtractor — descriptor role (POM dependencies + artifact).
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of MuleExtractor
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
